citations.assessment: Hosea explicitly names Beit Arbel in the simile within his rebuke.
Nittai and Yehoshua ben Peraḥyah receive the tradition together.
The pair is listed and the second member in the pair is designated head of the court.
The named entry cites the same pairing and names Yehoshua as Nasi.

holds.raw: והיא שומרון וי"א מקום סמוך לנינוה
holds.reason: The verse names Beit Arbel but does not settle Heilprin’s geographical alternatives. Do not equate it with the Galilean burial locality.
A separate digital transcription also reads הזונות, and the Mishnah supports the conjecture “of the pairs” by context. Keep the source difficulty explicit pending printed collation.
Ramban reports the joint burial tradition at Arbel but does not establish the stated coordinates or historical burial.

holds.raw: ובמ"ב פ' וישלח דינה נקברה בארבאל ואצלה ניתאי הארבלי
holds.reason: Ramban on the Vayishlaḥ passage gives a remarkably close parallel, the graves of Dinah and Nittai together at Arbel. This verifies a matching tradition, while the siglum מ״ב remains unidentified.

holds.raw: ובגא"י כתב בארבאל נקבר ניתאי ור' זעירא ועל השדה קבורים ד' שבטים ודינה אחותם ושת בן אדם הראשון
holds.reason: The provisional expansion Gelilot Eretz Yisrael requires the exact edition and passage. Ramban’s nearby parallel concerns Dinah and Nittai and does not include the other burial attributions.
